name: The People's Militia
summary: In southern Westfall, volunteers of The People's Militia press their fight against the Defias. The seasoned brigands hold the Dagger Hills, and Gryan Stoutmantle leads a campaign to clear the roads and farms. Complete the patrols, and you earn full induction at Sentinel Hill.

sections.title: Purging the Dagger Hills
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood has brought great hardship to Westfall's northern farmlands. Those who escaped Gryan Stoutmantle's first sweeps fled south to the rocky Dagger Hills. From there, Defias Highwaymen, Pathstalkers, and Knuckledusters still raid homesteads and waylay travelers. You join hardened recruits sent into the hills to break the brigands' hold over southern Westfall.

sections.title: Stoutmantle's Crusade
sections.body: After returning from the fight against the Scourge in Lordaeron, Gryan Stoutmantle found Westfall abandoned by Stormwind's royal garrison. A criminal syndicate went unchecked, and hunger drove farmers from their land. So he rallied local volunteers to take up arms. Complete this final patrol, and Stoutmantle blesses you in the Light as he formally inducts you into the militia. The fight against the Brotherhood deepens.

faq.answer: The Dagger Hills lie in southern Westfall, southwest of Sentinel Hill. Their rugged ridges and abandoned mineheads give the Defias Brotherhood's tougher fighters ground to gather and hold.

faq.q: Why is the People's Militia fighting the Defias alone?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and resources stretched thin, Stormwind's House of Nobles refuses to send the royal army to protect rural Westfall. Gryan Stoutmantle and local farmers form their own volunteer force to defend their homes.

faq.q: What does completing this task achieve?
aliases: what do i get for finishing
faq.answer: Clearing out the Highwaymen, Pathstalkers, and Knuckledusters breaks the Defias hold on southern Westfall's roads. You earn formal induction into the People's Militia under Gryan Stoutmantle's command.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran soldier who fought the Scourge in Lordaeron during the Third War. He returned to Westfall and saw that the Kingdom of Stormwind had abandoned its rural peasantry. At Sentinel Hill, he founded the People's Militia to fight the Defias.

faq.q: What kind of Defias hide in the Dagger Hills?
faq.answer: The Dagger Hills shelter experienced Defias Highwaymen, deadly Pathstalkers, and brutal Knuckledusters. They lead raids across southern Westfall and guard the Brotherhood's deeper strongholds.

faq.q: How does this connect to Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle says he recently returned from the tainted lands of Lordaeron, where the Alliance fought the Scourge. Surviving that grim fight gave him resolve to organize Westfall's defense after local authorities failed.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you stand up for forgotten countrymen whose livelihoods the capital's political elite abandoned.
As a paladin, you hear Stoutmantle call on the Light to bless new inductees. His words reflect the holy ideals of justice and protecting the defenseless from predatory outlaws.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind's failure to protect Westfall force common folk to shed their own blood to keep order in their homeland.
